g.aria-label: Why Deep Learning Favors Minibatch SGD Over Closed Forms
1. Analytic Normal Equations / lstsq [O(nd² + d³) flops]
At d = 10⁸ params, a d×d Gram matrix needs 40 PB of RAM!
Reads all n = 10⁷ examples just to take 1 parameter update
3. Minibatch Stochastic Gradient Descent [O(|B|d) per step]
Updates in O(d) memory & O(|B|d) time, independent of n!
